claim: Code relocated into 0x3Dxx may stop a native JNext run, with the DivMMC automatic-paging region as a suspected but unproven cause.
limit: On JNext the cause is still not proven; only the move from 3D80 to 3600 is shown to help. On the N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone, core 3.03.00, nxsuite XD2) a $3Dxx fetch does map DivMMC at once.

evidence.text: Relocated padding copy at 3D80 passed the simple model but stopped native JNext after 17 updates; moved to 3600 it ran 180 updates matching state at every update. The 3Dxx automatic-paging cause is an inference.
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite XD2): with automap on and ROM3 selected, an instruction fetch at $3Dxx mapped DivMMC at once: the suspected cause is real on a board.
